caption: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Precision Pain & Spine Institute LLC
citation_line: Government Employees Insurance Co. v. Precision Pain & Spine Institute LLC, No. 3:21-cv-16255; rev'd, 98 F.4th 463 (3d Cir. 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Shipp denied as moot a medical practice's motion to compel arbitration after GEICO amended its complaint in an insurance-fraud action.
qualification_rationale: The consolidated appeal resolved both the arbitrability of New Jersey IFPA claims and whether a district court may treat a motion aimed at a superseded complaint as automatically moot.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed in a precedential opinion, held that courts have discretion to apply an existing motion to an amended pleading, and directed arbitration of the IFPA claim.
